newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker on baht pressure.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker on baht pressure.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly weaker on Thursday, after tumbling on Wednesday due to the sharp fall in the Thai baht following the flotation of the currency, Japanese traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 2.1 yen per kg lower. Benchmark December was off 112.3 yen.

The prices started firmer amid caution that prices were too low after plunging on Wednesday, but weaker overseas prices due to the baht flotation sent prices into negative territory by the close. "Sentiment remains bearish with no bullish factors in sight," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
